Alright, here's what I've got across your three things.

**Laundry card** — The notice says the machines only take the laundry card (no coins, no other payment method). The problem is the balance on the old card does **not** carry over to a replacement. So whatever was on the lost card is gone. You top up at the management office counter (Suite 1) during office hours.

**Chest of drawers / bulk waste** — Bulk (furniture that won't fit in a bin) goes down the evening **before** the Tuesday morning round, between **18:00 and 20:00**, and only in the marked bay at the back of the bin room. If it's found there outside that two-hour window, a **$75 charge** goes on your flat's account and they won't reverse it — so if you miss the window, carry it back up and wait for the next Tuesday. Also: the chest is fine for the round (not electrical or upholstered), but anything taller than waist height needs **two people** to carry it down.

**Text to Maeve** — Sent to (555) 026-2418: *"Still want the microwave? I'm clearing the flat out tonight, so say the word and it's yours."*

For the laundry card, you might want to check with the office whether they can at least see what the old balance was before you buy a new one. And for the chest, this week's Tuesday is tomorrow — so tonight between 6 and 8pm is your window if you want it gone on this round.
